components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The committed action for changes that require operator confirmation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid #175bcc; border-radius: 6px; background: #175bcc; color: #fff; font: 650 14px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #124ba9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1769e0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A lower-emphasis action on a white working surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid #c8d0dc; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: #26354b; font: 650 14px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f2f5f8; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1769e0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Action
components.description: A quiet inline action for moving between related console views.
components.css: .ds-text-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #175bcc; font: 650 14px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-text-action:hover { color: #124ba9; } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1769e0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Identifier Field
components.description: A labeled field for an immutable GitHub or destination identifier.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: #42516a; font: 650 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #c9d1dd; border-radius: 5px; background: #fff; color: #17243a; font: 400 14px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #667085; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1769e0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Console Navigation
components.description: The active item in the dark operator navigation rail.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 5px; width: 220px; padding: 16px; background: #121a2b; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #9cadc8; font: 400 14px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #202c43; color: #f7faff; } .ds-nav-item-active { border-color: #384965; background: #26344f; color: #fff; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1769e0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: A compact, text-bearing delivery state marker.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; font: 650 12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: capitalize; } .ds-status-pill-success { background: #e7f8ee; color: #176c3c; } .ds-status-pill-success:hover { filter: brightness(0.98); }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: A flat white surface for comparing normalized delivery records.
components.css: .ds-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid #dce1e8; background: #fff; } .ds-table-wrap table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font: 400 14px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-table-wrap th { padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #dce1e8; background: #fafbfd; color: #657389; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-align: left; } .ds-table-wrap td { padding: 15px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e9ef; color: #3e4c61; } .ds-table-wrap tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-table-wrap strong, .ds-table-wrap small { display: block; } .ds-table-wrap strong { color: #1d2a3d; } .ds-table-wrap small { margin-top: 4px; color: #68758b; font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Readiness Band
components.description: The singular readiness callout for the active gateway policy.
components.html:
Gateway policy is active

OIDC admission and asynchronous delivery are independently enforced.
components.css: .ds-readiness { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 20px 22px; border: 1px solid #cfdbb4; border-left: 4px solid #8aa84b; background: #fbfdf5; } .ds-readiness-copy { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; column-gap: 10px; align-items: center; } .ds-readiness-copy strong { color: #162033; font: 700 15px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-readiness-copy p { grid-column: 2; margin: 5px 0 0; color: #596a42; font: 400 14px/1.55 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-readiness-dot { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: #5d9130; }

components.name: Confirmation Dialog
components.description: A protected confirmation surface for irreversible or externally visible changes.
components.html:
!

Trust workflow release

This full SHA will be eligible to submit notifications once its workflow ref also matches.
components.css: .ds-dialog-backdrop { position: fixed; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 20px; background: rgb(16 24 40 / 0.44); } .ds-dialog { width: min(100%, 460px); padding: 28px; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 22px 65px rgb(16 24 40 / 0.28); color: #162033; } .ds-dialog-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; margin-bottom: 18px; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff1ca; color: #815700; font: 700 20px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0 0 10px; font: 700 20px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dialog p { margin: 0; color: #536278; font: 400 14px/1.55 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dialog-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 10px; margin-top: 26px; } .ds-dialog button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1769e0; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Oidrune's operator console should feel like a quiet control room for a security-sensitive relay: precise, legible, and ready to explain what happened. The interface gives operational facts the first read, keeps the brand signal deliberate, and uses structure rather than decoration to establish confidence.

The dark navigation rail is the stable outer shell. The work area is a cool paper surface with white working surfaces, restrained borders, and a single reliable action blue. Signal Lime belongs to the Oidrune identity and to carefully chosen readiness moments; it is not a general-purpose fill. The result is a compact operational tool that stays calm when delivery needs attention.
keyCharacteristics: A dark, anchored navigation shell with a light operator work area.
Dense but breathable information blocks built for scanning and comparison.
Semantic color cues paired with explicit words and accessible focus states.
Flat surfaces by default, with elevation reserved for protected confirmation.

rules.name: The Signal-Then-Label Rule
rules.body: Status colors can cue success, failure, warning, or acceptance, but a word label always carries the meaning.

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep Oidrune Lime for brand marks and deliberate readiness signals; do not wash ordinary controls or whole sections in lime.

rules.name: The Data-Has-A-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the mono face for code, immutable identifiers, and measurements only; keep prose in Inter.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; elevation appears only where a protected confirmation needs clear focus.

dos: Do use the approved B2 console lockup on dark navigation surfaces and the compact inverse mark at the mobile breakpoint.
Do keep Relay Blue for actions and Oidrune Lime for identity or deliberate readiness signals.
Do pair every semantic color cue with an explicit text label and a visible keyboard focus state.
Do keep compact text and placeholders at a 4.5:1 minimum contrast ratio against their assigned surface.
Do reserve mono typography for immutable IDs, SHAs, and other exact data.
Do preserve flat working surfaces and use borders or tonal layering for ordinary hierarchy.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, decorative blobs, or broad glow effects into the operator console.
Don't use lime as a generic button, panel, or page background.
Don't use status color without the corresponding written outcome or status.
Don't replace the documented small-radius language with oversized soft cards or gratuitous pills.
Don't use a shadow to solve hierarchy that a 1px rule or tonal surface can express.
Don't use a confirmation dialog for simple navigation or a task that has no protected side effect.
